tools.name: finish_teaching
tools.description: Hand over the demonstrations you have shown and end teaching. Call this when the set is complete; nothing further is added afterwards.

content.text:
All eight demonstration pairs were accepted and their outputs computed correctly. The set covers:
- vertical doubling (keep top half) at 4, 6, and 8 rows,
- horizontal doubling (keep left half) at widths 4, 6, and 8,
- a fully 2×2-tiled grid (vertical halving takes precedence, keeping the top, horizontally-doubled half).

Handing over the set now.
